prompted_for: Systems page section 'What changes on your site' (battery limits, footprint, power/feed/drain, installation, approvals, tie-in, sanitizing chemicals, isolation); art direction: split-screen contrast, navy/limestone split where the divide is the battery limit, tie-in points on the seam
composition: canvas cut exactly in half: deep navy left, limestone right
small mono eyebrow '03 / ALL SYSTEMS' centred at top
huge heavy uppercase headline spanning both halves, white on navy turning navy on limestone
second large heavy uppercase label crossing the seam mid-canvas
outlined spec cards: four on the left, four on the right, numbered 01-08, each with Item/Typical/Note rows
a vertical rail on the seam with labelled nodes ('Tie-in point', 'Utility intake'); connector lines run from cards to the nodes
small glowing dots on connector lines
layout_devices: split-screen with content crossing the divide
elbowed connector lines from cards to seam
palette: white type on navy, navy type on limestone
steel-blue connector lines and node glows
typography: heavy condensed uppercase display headline with full stop
uppercase card titles with slash numbering
small sans table text inside cards
motion_implied: split slides apart to reveal the seam
connector lines draw from each card to the seam
glow dots travel along connectors into the tie-in nodes
t2i_keywords: hard vertical seam down the centre
thin elbowed connector lines to the seam
vertical rail with labelled nodes on the seam
t2i_prompt: A wide web page section split exactly in half: deep navy on the left, warm limestone on the right, the vertical seam representing a boundary. A small mono eyebrow label sits centred at the top above a large headline that crosses the seam and inverts colour, white on navy and navy on limestone. Square-cornered outlined cards with numbered titles and short key-value rows sit on both halves: <CONTENT>. Thin steel-blue elbowed connector lines run from each card to labelled nodes on a vertical rail along the seam. Flat UI mockup, hairline borders, no people.
signature_idea: The page split itself is the battery limit: Aquemi's scope on one side, the site's on the other, with tie-in points sitting on the seam.
strengths: the split-as-battery-limit metaphor is strong and directly relevant
uses both brand surfaces (navy and limestone) in one section
card key/value rows are easy to build and scan
connector lines into the seam make the integration idea tangible
weaknesses: heavy condensed uppercase type is far off the Geist light brand voice
duplicate '03' card, overlapping second headline crossing cards: cluttered and partly illegible
cards do not actually sit on the correct side of the limit (who supplies what is not encoded)
glow dots feel techy-gamer rather than calm
brand_fit_why: Right colours and a great seam idea, but loud heavy uppercase display type, glows and cluttered overlapping text break the precise, calm, light-headline brand.
